in_marathi.name: Chitrang
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitrang is a unisex name, derived from the Sanskrit words 'chitra' (picture) and 'anga' (part). It symbolizes someone with distinct features and unique personality.
